//: TODO(design): all numbers are working values. Times in seconds, distances in hexes. Status flags: canWalk / canAttack / canChannel (cauterizing, praying) false = the human can't; flees = runs away from the body; damageTakenMultiplier 1.25 = takes 25% more; endsOnDamage = any hit ends it; breaksWhenHolderTakes = for holds, the hold breaks when the holding head takes that much damage.

corroded.//: Put on by the Acid Spitter: eats armor and hurts a little every second.

soaked.//: Put on by Mist clouds: people in the mist slow down. Wears off soon after they leave it.

terrified.//: Put on by the Screamer: runs away from the hydra, doesn't fight, stops burning stumps.

seized.//: Wrapped in the Strangler's neck (GAME_DESIGN.md 6.5): doesn't walk, attack or channel; the other heads hit it 25% harder. The grip breaks when the Strangler takes 8 damage.

entranced.//: Staring into the Lantern's light (GAME_DESIGN.md 6.5): doesn't attack or channel. Any damage wakes it up. Heads leave Entranced humans alone unless ordered.

pinned.//: TODO(design): not one of the six statuses in GAME_DESIGN.md 3. Biter's Lockjaw: the human keeps fighting but can't walk away.

charmed.//: TODO(design): not one of the six statuses in GAME_DESIGN.md 3. The Spare's Be Adorable: stops fighting (and burning), but not because of fear.

melted.//: TODO(design): not one of the six statuses in GAME_DESIGN.md 3. Acid Spitter's Melt: no armor at all for a while.

mistCloud.//: Left by the Mist Breather where its attack lands. radius 1 = that hex and its six neighbours.

twinLoss.//: When a head dies, each head from the same stump falls into a rage (attacks faster) or into grief (slower), at random, for a while. Tender's Mend ends grief.

spareMischief.//: When a combo goes off while The Spare is alive, with this chance it adds one of these on the combo's target.

combos.description: A bite on a Corroded human. Heavy damage, and its armor breaks for good.
Acid spat into a Mist cloud. The cloud burns everyone in it for a while.
A Torchbearer in a Mist cloud. The torch goes out for a few seconds.
The Glutton on a Terrified human with little HP left. Eaten at once.
combos.//: Glutton on a Terrified human with low HP: eaten at once.

combos.description: Two Screamers scream within a second. A stun twice as wide.
combos.//: Two Screamers scream within 1 s of each other: a stun twice as wide.

combos.description: Two Biters bite one human from opposite sides. It falls over.
combos.//: Two Biters bite the same human from opposite sides of the body: it falls over.

combos.description: Two heads from one stump hit the same human. Extra damage.
combos.//: Two heads from the same stump hit the same human: extra damage. When one dies, the other rages or grieves (twinLoss above).

combos.description: Three heads from one stump hit the same human. More extra damage.
A bite on a Seized human. Double damage, and the grip lasts longer.

lines.speaker: biter
lines.text: I know. I can see him.

combos.description: The Glutton on a Seized human under half HP. Eaten at once.
Coil on a Soaked human. Extra damage, and Stunned when let go.
A scream into a Mist cloud. Everyone inside is Terrified.
combos.//: TODO(design): knights in the cloud are Stunned 1 s instead, once there are knights.

combos.description: Sonic Crack on a Corroded human. Its armor shatters and the shards hurt those nearby.
The Glutton eats a Corroded human. The body heals twice as much.
combos.//: The Glutton eats a Corroded human: the body heals twice as much (the extra healBody is the same as the Glutton's devourHeal).

combos.description: A lick on a Soaked human. It slips: Stunned.
A scream at an Entranced human. Stunned for long.
Acid on an Entranced human. Taken for holy oil: the trance goes on, and Corroded lasts twice as long.
combos.//: The Order takes the acid for holy oil: the trance goes on, and Corroded lasts twice as long.

combos.description: A Beacon lit in a Mist cloud. It draws from further away and takes the torches of those who come.
combos.//: A Beacon lit in a Mist cloud draws from 2 hexes further, and a Torchbearer who comes to it loses the torch.

combos.description: A Beacon lit while someone is Terrified. The Terrified run to the light and kneel.
combos.//: A Beacon lit while someone is Terrified: the Terrified run to the light, wherever they are, and kneel.
